summary: Sets out requirements for DHCPv6 failover. DHCPv6 lets several servers share a network but gives them no way to share lease information, so redundancy is hard to do reliably. This document lists requirements, related problems and the proposed scope of a solution.

eli5.summary: If two helpers hand out seats, they need to share a list, or both give away the same seat. This asks for a shared list.

questions: how to make dhcpv6 servers redundant
